TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Modifies a pricing rule that is being used for payments on EVA platform
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: The transaction reads pricingRuleId, pricingRuleRequest and the request header user code, then invokes ABKOR001.executePutPricingRules(pricingRuleId, pricingRuleRequest, auditUserId). The library loads the existing pricing rule and its active details, copies the existing pricingRuleType into pricingRuleRequest, validates that the rule is active, in an allowed status, without active child rules when status is SYC, and that pricingRuleRequest.effectiveDate.startDate is in the future; it also validates duplicate configurations and resolves detail values for pricingRuleRequest.details. 2. Decisions and branches: If no rule exists for pricingRuleId, the library adds advice ABKO10000405 and returns null. If a validation or duplicate check throws PricingRuleException, the library adds the exception code and description as advice and returns null. If existing comments, precedenceType or progressiveType are present and missing in pricingRuleRequest, those values are copied into the request before persistence. When the existing status is SYC, the library creates a new version, sets pricingRuleRequest.parentId to pricingRuleId, increments the version and sets status to PAU. Otherwise, it synchronizes detail additions and removals, sets pricingRuleRequest.status to PAU and sets parentId to existing.parentId or existing.id before updating the current rule. 3. Libraries and methods invoked: The transaction invokes ABKOR001.executePutPricingRules. Inside that flow, the repository methods getPricingRuleById, getDetailsByRuleId, hasActiveChildren, fillDetailValues, syncDetails, getNextId, insertAudit, insertPricingRule and insertDetails can run depending on the branch. 4. Errors and actions after errors: The flow can add advice ABKO10000405, ABKO10000407, ABKO10000408, ABKO10000417, ABKO10000413, ABKO10000414, ABKO10000416, ABKO10010401, ABKO10010415, ABKO10010004 and ABKO00000010. After the library call, the transaction always executes assignSeverityError(getAdviceList()); when the advice list is not empty it sets severity EWR. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: The transaction always executes setPricingruleresponse(pricingRule). On success it returns the modified pricing rule with resolved detail values, status PAU and either the original id or the new version id created for SYC rules; on error paths the output container is assigned with the null result returned by the library.

Accessed Libraries.Description: Validates the pricing rule to modify, resolves detail values, updates the existing rule or creates a new version for synchronized rules, and returns the modified pricing rule.
